requirements.summary: Every flop is assigned to a declared clock port, and flops with an asynchronous reset are counted; designs with one, two and three clocks are read.
A crossing through two or three directly connected flops is recognised as a synchroniser, also behind an inverter, and a two-stage reset synchroniser is accepted.
Each of the six rules reports its negative example, and nothing else is reported there.
The crossings of three existing examples agree with the reviewed ledger, and every finding there is excused by a waiver that is still valid.
A waiver that expired, that matches no finding, or that has no reason, is rejected.
A checker with one rule switched off is noticed, and what the checker cannot read is an error, never a clean result.
Designs composed at random from the patterns give exactly the findings their construction predicts.
